items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: I have two handmade guitars by a maker named Rick McCurdy in New York that are wonderful

ctx.x: We tend to collect. Yeah I don’t know how it happens. I had an old Les Paul, I’ve got my Ibanez, I’ve got a wonderful old 175, a used 175 from the 50s, which I never bring on the road but it’s probably the best guitar I have. I have two handmade guitars by a maker named Rick McCurdy in New York that are wonderful, a big archtop and then a small body guitar, also lovely. And I have played them, they’ve all been on the road, they’ve all been on a record date, I mean they’ve all had some use but you can’t use them…
